summary: @wiobyrne Awesome way to think about the book. I think we made huge mistep when we said, "Web 2.0 , no nobody needs to know html" When we should have been critical and said, "uh-oh lot of dangerous tech, maybe we should make sure everyone knows HTML" #lra18
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @wiobyrne Awesome way to think about the book. I think we made huge mistep when we said, "Web 2.0 , no nobody needs to know html" When we should have been critical and said, "uh-oh lot of dangerous tech, maybe we should make sure everyone knows HTML" #lra18
